description: Total income recognised across all INCOME-type ledger accounts (rental, electricity, guest stay, onboarding, late fees, exit charges, other), for whatever date range is queried.

source_columns: journal_lines.debit, journal_lines.credit, journal_lines.account_id; journal_entries.entry_date, is_reversal_of; coa_accounts.account_type, normal_balance

date_field: journal_entries.entry_date (journal_lines carries this denormalised at export)
aggregation: SUM(signed_amount), signed_amount = CASE normal_balance WHEN 'CREDIT' THEN credit-debit ELSE debit-credit END

allowed_questions: Direct questions about revenue (total, ledger-derived) (current value, trend, by-period, by-property where grain supports it).
prohibited_questions: None beyond the metric's own documented scope (see Known limitations).

description: Cash inflow recognised in the ledger against receipts, on the cash/bank accounts.
definition: SUM(debit) WHERE journal_entries.source_table='receipts' AND account_code IN ('1110','1120'), reversal-excluded.

historical_policy: Same ledger window as receipts-sourced postings (46 months of receipts activity within the ledger's 2019-2026 span).
validation_reference: No same-definition comparable reference is wired, so this metric is UNVERIFIED. Two readings are computed and both are returned: (1) occupied at any point in the month, (2) held on the last day of the month the export covers. Neither is selected. Bed universe is Live beds in Live apartments, the same universe as M.OCC.001 Def A/B. This is a bed COUNT per month, not the day-weighted ratio of M.OCC.003/004.
